$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this file, typically "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ryoku-dev/hyakki/main/schemas/t3.json".

iconPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the project icon (e.g. "assets/logo.svg"). Checked before Hyakki's built-in icon locations.

defaultThreadEnvMode.description: Where new threads start for this repository: "worktree" for a fresh git worktree, "local" for the current checkout. A per-project setting in Hyakki overrides this; when neither is set, the global default applies.

worktreeSubmodules.description: How new worktrees populate git submodules: "recursive" (the default) initializes nested submodules too, "top-level" initializes only those declared by this repository, and "none" leaves every submodule empty for a setup script to handle. A project or environment setting in Hyakki overrides this.

ignoreRepositories.description: Repositories inside the project folder that Hyakki should leave out of the project, as paths relative to it, such as vendor/big. They are then neither reviewed on their own nor given worktrees.

create.description: Shell command that lays out a thread's folder for a project tracking several repositories, in place of Hyakki's own worktrees and links. It runs in the project folder with T3_WORKTREE_ROOT (the folder to fill), T3_WORKTREE_PROJECT_PATH (where the project folder goes inside it), T3_WORKTREE_BRANCH, T3_WORKTREE_BASE, T3_WORKTREE_REPOSITORIES (the chosen repositories, one path per line) and T3_PROJECT_ROOT set. Each of the project's repositories it checks out at the same relative place is adopted as the thread's checkout of it, and must be a git worktree of that repository on T3_WORKTREE_BRANCH. It runs again when the folder goes missing, so it must cope with the branch already existing. It has ten minutes.

remove.description: Shell command that takes the thread's folder down again, with the same variables. It can run on a folder that is partly gone, and should delete what create generated. Hyakki removes the checkouts it leaves behind.

worktreeLayout.description: Lets the project create and remove a worktree thread's folder itself, for layouts with shared build output or workspace metadata.

worktreeSparsePatternsPath.description: Repository-relative path to a git sparse-checkout pattern file in non-cone syntax (e.g. ".t3/sparse-checkout"). New worktrees check out only the files it matches. Both files are read from the branch being checked out; a missing pattern file fails the worktree instead of checking out everything.

name.description: Display name for the script, shown in the Hyakki scripts menu.

command.description: Shell command executed in a Hyakki terminal at the project root.

icon.description: Icon shown next to the script in the scripts menu. Defaults to "play".

runOnWorktreeCreate.description: When true, the script runs automatically after a worktree is created for a new thread.

runOnSettle.description: When true, the script runs in the thread's worktree each time the thread settles, for example to delete build output. Threads without their own worktree skip it.

stopOnSettle.description: When true, Hyakki stops this action's terminal and child processes when its thread settles.

async.description: Only for runOnWorktreeCreate scripts. When true (the default), the agent starts while the script is still running. Set false to hold the agent until the script exits.

previewUrl.description: URL opened in the in-app browser preview when this script runs. Only honored on the desktop build.

autoOpenPreview.description: When true, automatically open the preview panel at `previewUrl` the moment the script starts.

items.description: A project script that team members can import into Hyakki.

scripts.description: Project scripts shared with everyone who opens this repository in Hyakki.

title: Hyakki project file
description: Checked-in project configuration for Hyakki (t3.json at the repository root). See https://github.com/Ryoku-dev/hyakki for documentation.
